questions.question: Why was Gojo's birth such a big deal for the jujutsu world?
questions.subject: Satoru Gojo/Synopsis

answer.item: He was the first person in approximately four hundred years to inherit both the Limitless inherited technique and the Six Eyes.

questions.question: How did young Gojo manage to spot Toji Zenin following him?
questions.subject: Satoru Gojo/Synopsis

answer.item: While tailing the child, Satoru noticed Toji's presence and turned around to look at him, surprising Toji.

questions.question: How did Gojo survive Toji Zenin's attack on him?
questions.subject: Satoru Gojo/Synopsis

answer.item: Unbeknownst to Toji, Gojo learned how to perform reverse cursed technique on the verge of death, allowing him to heal himself.

questions.question: Why didn't Gojo kill Geto when the two finally met in Shinjuku?
questions.subject: Satoru Gojo/Synopsis

answer.item: Gojo considers killing his best friend but is unable to bring himself to do so.

questions.question: Why did Gojo decide to bring Yuta to Jujutsu High instead of letting him be executed?
questions.subject: Satoru Gojo/Synopsis

answer.item: Realizing Yuta's potential, Gojo instead brings him back to Tokyo Jujutsu High and convinces the higher-ups to push off his execution and to let Yuta join the college.

questions.question: How did Gojo plan to break the curse binding Rika?
questions.subject: Satoru Gojo/Synopsis

answer.item: Gojo explains to Yuta that he will need to pour the powers of the curse through the katana in order to break the curse

questions.question: What did Gojo tell Yuji he had to do before being executed?
questions.subject: Satoru Gojo/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji has to eat all of Sukuna's fingers before being executed.

questions.question: How does Yuji help the sorcerers track down the remaining fingers of Sukuna?
questions.subject: Satoru Gojo/Synopsis

answer.item: Gojo explains that Yuji is now a radar that can find Sukuna's fingers since he has become Sukuna's vessel.

questions.question: What did Gojo and Nanami retrieve from Junpei Yoshino's home?
questions.subject: Satoru Gojo/Synopsis

answer.item: one of the Sukuna's cursed fingers from Junpei Yoshino's home

questions.question: What stopped Gojo from entering the barrier at the Kyoto Goodwill Event?
questions.subject: Satoru Gojo/Synopsis

answer.item: Gojo is the only one that can't enter the screen.

questions.question: What did Gojo say a Black Flash actually is?
questions.subject: Satoru Gojo/Synopsis

answer.item: the basic premise of Black Flash being a distortion in space that occurs when cursed energy is applied within 0.000001 seconds of a physical hit

questions.question: What caused the box to seal Gojo during the Shibuya Incident?
questions.subject: Satoru Gojo/Synopsis

answer.item: Gojo's confusion about Geto's apparent revival causes one minute of time to pass within his mind as he flashes back on all of his memories with him. This causes the box's sealing condition to be fulfilled and wraps itself around Gojo.

questions.question: How did jujutsu society treat Gojo's seal after the Shibuya Incident?
questions.subject: Satoru Gojo/Synopsis

answer.item: Removing his seal is now considered as a criminal act, and anyone who does remove the seal will be considered a traitor.

questions.question: What stopped Gojo from killing Kenjaku right after he was unsealed?
questions.subject: Satoru Gojo/Synopsis

answer.item: upon his unsealing confronts Kenjaku and attempts to kill him but is prevented from doing so by Sukuna

questions.question: What did Gojo do to the higher-ups before his final fight?
questions.subject: Satoru Gojo/Synopsis

answer.item: he proceeded to kill all the higher ups in the room

questions.question: How did Sukuna finally defeat Gojo?
questions.subject: Satoru Gojo/Synopsis

answer.item: Sukuna's world cutting clash bisected Gojo horizontally, completely severing the top half of his body.
